comparison.objective: Move five fragile upright tiles into a box in as few trips as possible.
comparison.physical_skill: Batch grasping and transporting multiple thin upright objects without tipping or dropping.
comparison.success_condition: All tiles stand inside the box with no tip, fall, or drop; score depends on trip count.
comparison.reason: Fragile multi-object transport tests batch grasp stability and risk management, not mechanical adjustment or commissioning.
